project_info.theme: Galaxy Buds4 Pro Hi-Fi Sound macro poster
project_info.color_palette: Warm white, metallic silver, pale beige, black typography

main_subject.detail: Extreme macro poster focusing on the brushed-metal speaker grille area of a Galaxy Buds4 Pro earbud, paired with a short Hi-Fi sound headline on a clean pale background.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic macro hardware render, premium audio-detail advertising

items: Top Left: Soft out-of-focus white earbud body filling the background.
Bottom Left: Brushed-metal earbud stem extending diagonally from lower left toward center.
Bottom Right: Minimal empty pale background space.
Center/Background: Macro oval speaker grille mesh framed at the end of the metallic stem with a shallow depth-of-field product aesthetic.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Brushed-metal shimmer, subtle depth blur, delicate premium highlight rolloff

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy Buds4 Pro Hi-Fi Sound macro poster. Centerpiece is an extreme macro of a Galaxy Buds4 Pro earbud focusing on the oval speaker grille and brushed-metal stem. Background is a pale, softly blurred close-up of the earbud body. Surrounding elements: short black headline 'Hi-Fi Sound' placed at upper right with plenty of negative space. Technical style: photorealistic macro product render, soft macro studio lighting, metallic shimmer and shallow depth blur, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
